style: Painterly Japanese adventure-game background art, 1991 Showa/Heisei era coastal town, warm lantern light against cold night blues, rich film grain, cinematic composition, no text, no letters, no watermark, no people unless stated.

images.prompt: Night street of a declining Japanese harbor town in winter 1991. In the center, an old two-story wooden pawnshop (shichiya) with a lattice front, a dark indigo noren curtain and a glowing red paper lantern hanging at the left. A full moon over tiled rooftops, faint stars, wet asphalt reflecting the shop's amber light. Leave the upper-middle area calm and dark for a game logo.

Interior of an old Japanese pawnshop seen from behind the counter, facing the customer side. Dark wooden walls and shelves holding pawned goods: a vase, a mantel clock, a film camera, an electric guitar, folded kimono fabric, a sword rack. An indigo noren curtain in the middle, a small window at the right, a single hanging lamp casting warm light. The bottom quarter is the wooden counter top. Empty space in the center where a customer will stand.

Top-down view of a worn wooden low table in a Japanese back room at early morning. Soft winter sunlight slanting through shoji screens creating diagonal light bars, a cup of green tea at the lower right, an abacus edge at the lower left. The center is empty table surface (a newspaper UI will be placed there). Subtle vignette.

A pawnbroker's back office desk at night, seen from above at an angle. A brass desk lamp at the upper left casting a warm pool of light, an open ledger book, a wooden abacus at the lower right, scattered paper pawn tickets, a cash box. Most of the frame is dim and quiet so UI panels can sit on top.
The same old Japanese pawnshop at dawn, warm golden sunrise over the harbor, townspeople's silhouettes gathering in front of the shop, the paper lantern still glowing, hopeful mood.
The same old Japanese pawnshop in cold grey winter rain, metal shutter pulled down with a foreclosure notice taped on it (no readable text), the lantern unlit, empty street, melancholy mood.
